comment: The diagnostics the fixture must produce, expressed the way the normalized
diagnostic model expresses them: identity comes from ruleId, severity,
document, and span. Message text is deliberately absent — it is localized
(the recorded baseline was produced by a de-DE compiler) and no part of
Broiler Code may key behavior off it.
Spans are one-based line/column as reported by SARIF; the workspace stores
the zero-based offsets it derives from the same snapshot.
Not asserted, because the SDK's built-in analyzer set is a property of
the SDK version rather than of the fixture. Recorded because it matters:
SampleReports.Core produces two CA1510 diagnostics at SARIF level 'note',
which normalize to Information severity. `dotnet build` does not print
them at any default verbosity. A Problems pane fed from console text
would therefore be missing a severity class entirely — which is the
concrete reason the diagnostic channel is SARIF and not stdout.
It also supplies the Information severity that the Phase 3 exit gate
requires the UI to render and navigate.

diagnostics.purpose: The cross-file, cross-project error the Phase 0 exit gate maps back to an exact document snapshot.
A second severity from a second file, so the Problems pane cannot collapse the build into one row.
The warning survives correction, so 'build succeeded' must not mean 'Problems pane empty'.
